primitives.name: Working Tree Classifier
primitives.verbatim_quote: Classifies the working-tree changes so only safe, intended files are staged.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'\\mathcal{W}': 'working tree set, dimensionless', '\\mathcal{S}': 'staged subset of \\(\\mathcal{W}\\), dimensionless', '\\mathcal{F}': 'functional file set, dimensionless'}
primitives.assumptions: All files in \(\mathcal{W}\) are under \(\mathcal{D}_{\text{gse}}\); \(\mathcal{S} \subseteq \mathcal{F}\) holds iff all staged files are safe.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When \(\mathcal{W} \not\subseteq \mathcal{D}_{\text{gse}}\), classification fails due to out-of-scope files.
